name: Ren
about: Ren is a Japanese given name that can be written with different kanji, giving it several possible meanings. One common form uses the character 蓮, meaning 'lotus,' while other forms can carry different meanings and associations. Short, elegant and widely recognisable in modern Japanese naming, Ren is a distinctive gender-neutral choice with a quiet connection to nature.

name: River
about: River comes directly from the English word for a natural flowing body of water. As a modern word name, it evokes movement, freedom and the changing landscapes shaped by water. Familiar without being strongly gendered, River is an expressive gender-neutral choice with a natural sense of flow.

name: Robin
about: Robin developed as a medieval English diminutive of Robert, ultimately deriving from Germanic elements associated with 'bright' and 'fame.' The name is also strongly associated with the robin bird, giving it a second connection to the natural world. Familiar, warm and established across genders, Robin is a timeless gender-neutral choice with both historical and natural appeal.

name: Rowan
about: Rowan has roots in Irish naming traditions and is associated with the rowan tree, a small tree known for its clusters of bright red berries. The Irish name Ruadhán is also connected with the name, while the tree association has helped establish Rowan as a modern given name in English-speaking countries. Natural, gentle and established across genders, Rowan is a strong gender-neutral choice with Celtic character.

name: Rin
about: Rin is a Japanese given name that can be written with several different kanji, so its precise meaning depends on the form chosen. Documented forms include 凛, associated with dignity or a commanding presence, while other kanji can carry different meanings. Compact, refined and used across genders, Rin is a distinctive Japanese name with a clean modern character.

name: Rayan
about: Rayan is an Arabic name associated with the meaning 'watered' or 'luxuriant,' suggesting freshness and abundant growth. The name also has an important place in Islamic tradition through Ar-Rayyan, one of the gates of Paradise described in hadith for those who fast. Rich in cultural meaning while remaining accessible and contemporary, Rayan is a distinctive gender-neutral name.

name: Roni
about: Roni is a Hebrew name meaning 'my joy' or 'my song,' expressing happiness and celebration through its connection with the Hebrew root for joy and singing. It is used for people of more than one gender and has a warm, lyrical quality. Short, positive and culturally grounded, Roni is a gentle gender-neutral choice with an uplifting meaning.

name: Remy
about: Remy is the English form of the French name Rémy, which derives from the Latin personal name Remigius and is traditionally associated with an oarsman or rower. Long established in French-speaking cultures and increasingly familiar internationally, Remy has a polished yet approachable character. Its established use across genders makes it a versatile gender-neutral choice.

name: Riley
about: Riley developed from Irish and English surname traditions, with the Irish form associated with the Gaelic surname Ó Raghallaigh and the personal name Raghailleach. It later became an established given name and is now widely used across genders. Friendly, energetic and familiar without being strongly gendered, Riley is a versatile gender-neutral name with deep surname roots.

name: Ravid
about: Ravid is a Hebrew name meaning 'ornament' or 'necklace.' Its imagery suggests something precious, carefully made and valued, giving the name a quiet sense of beauty without relying on a strongly gendered tradition. Rare outside Hebrew-speaking communities, Ravid offers a distinctive and culturally rooted gender-neutral option for those looking beyond familiar names.

name: Rory
about: Rory is an Irish name derived from Ruaidhrí, traditionally associated with the meaning 'red king.' Established across Irish and Scottish naming traditions and now used for more than one gender in English-speaking countries, Rory combines Celtic heritage with a friendly, energetic sound.

name: Reese
about: Reese is an English form of the Welsh name Rhys, traditionally associated with qualities such as ardour and enthusiasm. Its compact sound and established use for multiple genders have made Reese a familiar and versatile gender-neutral choice.

name: Reagan
about: Reagan is an Irish surname-derived given name from Ó Riagáin, meaning 'descendant of Riagán.' Its modern use across genders has given it a distinctly contemporary character while retaining its Irish heritage and surname tradition.

name: Ripley
about: Ripley is an English surname and place name derived from Old English elements associated with woodland and a clearing. Rare as a given name but used for more than one gender, Ripley offers an unusual combination of English heritage, nature imagery and contemporary character.

name: Rei
about: Rei is a Japanese given name that can be written with several different kanji, so its precise meaning depends on the form chosen. Possible associations include ideas such as beauty, spirit or gratitude. Short, elegant and used across genders, Rei is a distinctive Japanese gender-neutral choice.

name: Rio
about: Rio is an internationally used name with Japanese forms that can be written with different kanji and therefore carry different meanings. It is also familiar in several other languages and cultures, giving it a broadly international character. Short, energetic and used across genders, Rio makes an accessible global gender-neutral choice.

name: Raven
about: Raven comes directly from the English name of the intelligent black bird. Ravens have carried rich symbolism in mythology and folklore across many cultures, often associated with mystery, wisdom and transformation. Used for more than one gender, Raven is a distinctive nature-inspired choice with strong visual character.

name: Ritsu
about: Ritsu is a Japanese given name that can be written with different kanji. One established form uses 律, associated with 'law' or 'order.' Compact and refined, Ritsu is used for more than one gender and offers a distinctive Japanese gender-neutral option with a strong, composed character.

name: Ryo
about: Ryo is a Japanese given name that can be written with different kanji, giving it several possible meanings and associations. Depending on the characters chosen, meanings can include ideas such as clarity, refreshing qualities or reality. Its short, clean sound and use across genders make Ryo a versatile Japanese gender-neutral name.

name: Rene
about: Rene is an English form of the French René and is ultimately derived from the Latin name Renatus, meaning 'born again' or 'reborn.' René and Rene have established use across genders in different linguistic contexts, giving the name a classic international character and a positive association with renewal.
